messages:
kyle: Noticing a weird spike in invoice variance after last night's SKU mapping migration. Several customers show a "phantom" line item (SKU "SK-TRIAL-0") with negative amounts, and some customers received duplicate finalized invoices. example: INV-2024-5892 and INV-2024-5892-dup for same order.

ana-finance: can you paste one invoice id + customer so we can reconcile ledger vs pdf?

kyle: INV-2024-5892 / cust-saas-701. Ledger shows credit memo -1200 for trial adjustment, but rendered pdfs show a separate negative line -1200 AND a positive reconciliation line +1200, cancelling in ledger but customer-facing totals differ depending on which pdf they got.

migration-bot: migration sku-mapping-v4 completed 2495000600 status=SUCCESS changes=134 files_modified=2

billing-bot: finalize_batch:202405_run status=SUCCESS 2495000900 invoices_finalized=15400 duplicates_emitted=14 previews_generated=15412

mike-ops: quick triage: sku-mapping-v4 flattened legacy trial SKU into two new SKUs but left a migration tombstone row that the renderer interprets as an extra line. tombstone row has negative amount to reverse old credit in ledger; renderer applies tombstone AND the new mapping -> double representation. duplicates come from finalize retry path where one worker used old mapping cache and another worker used updated mapping, both succeeded -> second got -dup suffix.

kyle: reproducer locally: 
```
# pseudo
line_items = map_items(order.items, sku_map)
# migration tombstone: sku_map contains entry 'SK-TRIAL-0' -> {'action':'tombstone','amount':-1200}
# renderer previously filtered tombstones
for entry in sku_map:
  if entry.action == 'tombstone':
    line_items.append(entry)  # incorrect: tombstones should only affect ledger
emit_invoice(line_items)
```

support-lead: got ~30 tickets. customers confused by two invoices with different totals and an unexplained negative line. some customers already paid the higher amount. need urgent comms + credit flow.

ana-finance: pause outbound invoice emails for batch 202405 and hold payouts. we'll need a list of affected invoice ids.

migration-bot: rollback option available: revert sku-mapping-v4 to previous commit (sha b7f2) or patch renderer to ignore entries marked tombstone.

mike-ops: safer fix: patch renderer to treat mapping entries with "tombstone" action as non-rendered adjustments (apply to ledger only) and add idempotency check on finalize to prevent duplicate invoice ids on retry. then re-finalize affected invoices.

billing-bot: queued job re_finalize_affected batch=202405 triggered by mike-ops at 2495001320

audit-bot: note: migration introduced 2 schema keys: sku_map.v4.tombstone_flag and sku_map.v4.source_ts. audit trail available in migration logs 2495000612-2495000625.

kyle: patch pushed to renderer at 2495001360 to ignore tombstone render lines and add canonical_order_id lock. running re-finalize job now.

billing-bot: re_finalize_affected completed 2495001420 status=SUCCESS duplicates_voided=14 phantom_lines_removed=42 credits_issued=28 refunds_initiated=4

support-lead: prioritizing outreach to customers who paid the higher amount. drafting message: "We found duplicate invoices and an internal migration artifact that caused a negative adjustment line to appear. We've corrected the invoices and issued credits/refunds where needed. No action required unless you have questions." approved by finance.

ana-finance: verified top-10 impacted accounts reconciliation. ledger now matches rendered invoices. follow-ups: 1) migration checklist must include render-preview smoke test, 2) add unit test for tombstone handling, 3) add alert if preview_count != expected_count by >1%.

audit-bot: creating incident record with migration logs and affected invoice list at incidents/2495001234.json

kyle: adding logs for postmortem: 
```
ERROR renderer: unexpected mapping entry action=tombstone for sku SK-TRIAL-0; rendered as line at 2495000689
WARN finalize: duplicate finalize for order ord-22401 -> emitted INV-2024-5892-dup at 2495000715
```

audit-bot: incident created and owners assigned: eng=mike-ops, finance=ana-finance, support=support-lead.

kyle: thanks all. will follow up with the postmortem doc and attach diffs. closing thread for now. :wave:
